findings.detail: New numeric labels insert spaces between Chinese text and Latin digit/placeholder runs, contrary to the zh-CN typography guide. Meaning and grammar remain clear.
findings.recommendation: Use compact Chinese typography, e.g. 已选{count}/8、最多选择8个标签、{count}个对话.

findings.detail: 正在保存标签… uses one ellipsis mark; zh-CN style guide specifies two (……), as already used by loading/applying baseline strings.
New strings introduce 请 although English does not say please; the zh-CN guide restricts this politeness marker. This is a register/style discrepancy, not a semantic defect.
findings.recommendation: Omit 请 in the three new messages when applying strict guide conformance.
